title: Damosa
description: A premium food & frozen desserts brand platform showcasing authentic samosa flavors and artisan ice creams. Features an elegant menu explorer, online ordering system, and immersive hero visuals that blend tradition with modern indulgence.

title: Pyramids
description: Corporate digital presence for a leading architectural and engineering firm renowned for designing landmark skyscrapers and iconic commercial malls across Pakistan. Showcases expertise, project portfolios, and development milestones through a cinematic, scroll-driven experience.

title: Lavita
description: A luxury mountain club platform nestled at 9,200 ft in Malam Jabba, Swat Valley. Highlights exclusive membership experiences — from world-class skiing and vertical gardens to stargazing observatories — through a refined, dark-themed interface exuding elegance and exclusivity.

title: Titan Enterprises
description: A role-based ERP system engineered for a detergent manufacturing factory, automating end-to-end production workflows, real-time inventory tracking, financial reporting, HR & payroll management, and a live command center dashboard with actionable business intelligence.

title: Peshawar Services Club
description: A full-stack digital ecosystem comprising a mobile app for members and a web-based CMS for administrators — enabling seamless management of facility bookings, room reservations, complaint tracking, and daily operations in real time across multiple departments.

title: Concordia Peshawar CMS
description: A comprehensive college management system empowering administrators with real-time control over academics, student records, fee collection, attendance, examination workflows, hostel operations, and financial reporting — all unified in a single, intuitive dashboard.

title: Haasil
description: Haasil is an e-commerce platform that offers a wide range of products, making it easy for customers to shop essentials online with convenience.
